name: poiesis-design
description: Design toolkit for Claude Code: poiesis-ui (how an interface looks), poiesis-ux (how an app behaves), poiesis-copy (what it says) and poiesis-components (the component set built on ui and ux).

plugins.name: poiesis-ui
plugins.description: How your interface looks: text sizes, hierarchy, spacing, color and shape (corners, lines, shadows), all derived from a few values you choose. Rules, an auditor that checks your code, and a gate that holds back publishing until the check passes.

plugins.name: poiesis-ux
plugins.description: How your app behaves for the people using it: rules for feedback, errors, control, keyboard use and honest choices, and a tester that does your app's main tasks the way a person would and reports what gets in their way.

plugins.name: poiesis-copy
plugins.description: What your product says, in English and Romanian: UX copy, landing pages, ads and email, written clear, concise and honest. Rules with sources, patterns for each piece, inspiration from copy you admire, your product's voice in one file, and a reviewer that checks the text.

plugins.name: poiesis-components
plugins.description: The Poiesis component library: tokens, primitives, thirteen fundamental components (every variant a setting) and patterns built from them, all its own, plain CSS with a few small custom elements and no dependencies, copied into any web project; change the atoms and every component follows. Shown in poiesis-gallery.
